_comment: Phase 8 (2026-11-02): GeoCore-9B (KAIST, arXiv 2608.01896) as a frozen comparator row in Table A under the
unchanged harness (raw pooled block-input tokens, StandardScaler + LR, val-selected t/C). Same datasets /
fractions / seeds / c_grid as phase2.json. dinov3-sat, flux-pretrained-k28 and flux-proj cells are cached from
phases 1-2 (identical cell_config -> reused). GeoCore k pins come from eval.sweep select on val
(experiments/isaac/geocore/select.sbatch) and are filled into per_dataset before the cells run; the k=8 default
below is a placeholder and MUST be overridden for every dataset (DRAFT marker removed when filled).
geocore-9b-256 = 256 px check (m_eurosat, m_so2sat only). geocore-9b-ditf = DiTF view with the model's own
discard channels from meta (supplement); only valid if the FLUX discard gate printed DISCARD_OK.
